The kerosene heater glows in the corner, casting a cozy glow over the space. In the cozy glow of the heater, Brooks, Arthur Finch, and Barnaby rest in comfortable silence as the town's holiday post finally rests in order. Barnaby curls into a tight ball on Brooks's lap as Arthur Finch rests his chin on his chest, dozing peacefully. The narrator says: <d>[English] The holiday post is completely sorted at last, and now we can all take a peaceful rest.</d> After this line the voice-over stays silent for the rest of the shot. The camera pulls back at slow speed from the warm center of the sorting room toward the doorway, fading softly.

overall_soundscape: The low, steady hum and gentle ticking of the kerosene heater emanate from the corner. Faint, rhythmic breathing accompanies the stillness of the room.
